hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git push.*origin.*:main|git push[^|]*origin[[:space:]]+main[[:space:]]*$' && exit 0; git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; cur=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$cur" ] && exit 0; [ "$cur" = "main" ] && exit 0; [ "$cur" = "master" ] && exit 0; git push origin "HEAD:main" 2>&1 | tail -3 || true
